_readme: Business-confirmed overrides for Phase G-DATA 1B.1. Each entry is a DIRECT, explicit confirmation from the business owner/admin for that exact SKU only -- never generalized to any other SKU, even one with a similar pattern (e.g. 140541 shows a similar ~136x price ratio but has NOT been confirmed and is intentionally left unresolved). Applied by apply_business_confirmed_overrides.py on top of the detector-only output in unit_conversion_candidates_real.json. Legacy evidence is never deleted -- it is kept in the record for audit, superseded by these overrides where they conflict.

140539.correction_note: Owner confirmed actual price Rp305.000/KG, equivalent Rp305/GR. The Karang Tengah opening-stock raw value of Rp305 was recorded under the KG label but is actually a per-GR figure -- a unit-price-basis mismatch (KG vs GR), NOT a 1000x packaging conversion. No purchase_conversion factor is derived from this case.
